paragraphs: Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems, and you want AI to be safe and beneficial for users and for society as a whole. As a member of the Applied AI team you will be a Forward Deployed Engineer who embeds directly with strategic customers to drive transformational AI adoption. You will work within customer systems to build production applications with Claude models, ensuring those products meet customer requirements, and you will deliver technical artifacts such as MCP servers, sub‑agents, and agent skills for production workflows.

I have built agentic solutions using Python and PostgreSQL while maintaining continuous integration and collaborating closely with stakeholders. In a separate project I created MCP services that combined search, GraphQL and open‑weight models on a PostgreSQL back‑end, also employing continuous integration. Both projects involved work with LLMs, advanced prompt engineering and agent development, producing production‑ready artifacts that satisfy deployment at scale. I ensured the artifacts met the required safety and reliability standards while communicating progress to stakeholders. I documented repeatable deployment patterns and fed insights back to product teams. My work demonstrates high agency and the ability to navigate ambiguity. I also contributed to evaluation frameworks measuring model performance significantly.

I delivered end‑to‑end data pipelines in Python, packaging components in Docker containers and deploying functions on AWS Lambda with appropriate IAM roles. This effort integrated fourteen source datasets into a unified service. I also built FastAPI applications that incorporated scikit‑learn, TensorFlow and Keras models, containerising them with Docker for consistent production deployment. Both initiatives required strong Python programming, attention to deployment at scale and clear communication with technical and non‑technical stakeholders. These experiences align with the requirement for Python expertise and demonstrate my capability to produce production‑grade AI solutions.
